title: L'Oréal allegedly explores unloading talc-related liabilities
summary: The beauty giant strongly contests the claims made in approximately 760 pending proceedings related to the alleged presence of asbestos particles in certain talc-containing cosmetic products. According to a new report, L’Oréal has allegedly tapped advisors Weil Gotshal & Manges and investment bank Ducera Partners
